questions.question: Which MICHELIN roster is authoritative for Feb 2027?
questions.known_official: Official 2025 ceremony article: 5 three-star + 15 two-star + 52 one-star = 72; live NYC filter: 5 + 14 + 50 = 69.
questions.why_or_next: No official 2026/2027 NYC ceremony roster was found; distinctions may change before travel. Re-check guide.michelin.com immediately before booking.

questions.question: Which hotel is chosen?
questions.why_or_next: No hotel is chosen in this audit. A chosen hotel is required before a door-to-door ≤60-minute activity/transit matrix can be meaningful.
questions.source_hint: Re-quote and compare official hotel pages

questions.question: What is the cheapest upcoming DATE TO BOOK?
questions.known_official: Current official quotes were sampled on 2026-11-25 for stays in Feb/Mar 2027.
questions.why_or_next: No official source publishes a future booking-date price curve. A repeat experiment on fixed future purchase dates is needed.

questions.question: Do quoted hotel rates require membership or sign-in?
questions.known_official: Arlo Soho pages show MEMBER RATE · SIGN IN.

questions.question: Are all quoted totals final all-in totals?
questions.known_official: Fairfield prints US$1,183.59 incl taxes/fees; citizenM/Moxy print tax and city tax as excluded.
questions.why_or_next: All-in totals for citizenM/Moxy are blank+flag; checkout totals must be captured.

questions.question: Can the 7-night baseline answer 1–2 weeks, 2–4 weeks, or preferred 3 nights?
questions.why_or_next: No. Other duration options remain blank+flag.

questions.question: Which restaurants currently have stars vs are Guide-listed only?
questions.known_official: Live filtered star lists and no-star detail pages are separated in this audit.
questions.why_or_next: A 2027 roster refresh is still required.

questions.question: What is the exact cost for 2 adults at each restaurant?
questions.known_official: Official menus publish per-person or per-guest prices.
questions.why_or_next: Two-adult totals are blank+flag because the totals are not printed as such; arithmetic is not entered as an official value.

questions.question: Which official hours apply in February 2027?
questions.known_official: MoMA, AMNH, NPS, High Line, Chelsea Market, and several MICHELIN restaurant pages publish current or seasonal hours. ESB and 9/11 pages publish rolling/2026 schedules.
questions.why_or_next: Feb 2027 hours for several venues are blank+flag; re-check the week of travel.

questions.question: What is the exact Statue of Liberty ferry schedule and price in Feb 2027?
questions.known_official: NPS prints park hours and ferry-only access; Statue City Cruises prints starting-at prices and 2026 calendar availability.
questions.why_or_next: Feb 2027 ferry schedule and exact two-adult total are blank+flag.

questions.question: What is the full ≤60-minute subway/bus cluster matrix?
questions.known_official: MTA publishes fare rules; MICHELIN publishes an official live star list.
questions.why_or_next: No official MTA door-to-door matrix was produced. Counts and ranks are blank+flag.

questions.question: Are the social links verified reviews?
questions.known_official: 27 direct YouTube pages were verified through official oEmbed endpoints.
questions.why_or_next: TikTok/Instagram direct review links are blank+flag. Search/account links are discovery-only.

questions.question: Do all activities have official social review links?
questions.why_or_next: No verified direct activity review link was captured; activity social cells are blank+flag.

questions.question: Which Broadway show and 2027 performance time?
questions.known_official: Broadway League official directory lists shows and a performance-times link.
questions.why_or_next: Feb 2027 show schedule, days, hours, and prices are blank+flag.

questions.question: What are cancellation and prepayment terms at booking time?
questions.known_official: Current Booking/MICHELIN quote pages print free-cancellation and prepayment terms.
questions.why_or_next: These are dynamic; re-capture at purchase time.

questions.question: Are modeled coordinates and straight-line clusters acceptable?
questions.known_official: docs/data/hotels.csv and docs/data/michelin_2025.csv contain modeled coordinates; deepdive transit uses a straight-line screen.
questions.why_or_next: No. Modeled coordinates and straight-line counts are flagged; leave verified transit values blank.
questions.source_hint: Repository files + MTA official source policy

questions.question: Which pages should be merged into the live site?
questions.known_official: audit/ contains a self-contained static sub-site.
questions.why_or_next: Final integration session must add “Verified audit” links from docs/index.html and deepdive/index.html, merge, verify links, and republish Pages.

questions.question: Can a reasonable final booking decision be made now?
questions.known_official: Many official-source values are verified, but key 2027-specific price, roster, hours, booking-date, and transit values remain blank+flag.
questions.why_or_next: No. Use the review workflow, resolve blockers, then choose a path.
